If you need to change something:
PWA: `sw.js` → cache-first for assets, network-first for code (v8, 30+ cached assets)
Build CSS: `npm install && npm run build:css` → generates minified style.css
Build Data: `npm run build:data` → inlines JSON into state.js
Build All: `npm run build` → builds CSS and data
Modals: `showModal(title, msg, type)` / `showConfirm(title, msg)` → Promise-based custom modals
Lookup: `SUBTOPIC_LOOKUP[id]` → O(1) access to subtopic data
